label.zh-TW: Lalamove 官網：司機推薦活動
label.en: Lalamove official site: driver referral program

steps.zh-TW: 用手機點擊「立即註冊」開啟連結（桌面瀏覽器只會顯示請改用手機）。
steps.en: On your phone, select “Sign up” to open the link (a desktop browser only asks you to switch to a phone).

steps.zh-TW: 依指示下載 Lalamove 司機版 App，只從官方上架頁安裝，並用本人手機註冊。
steps.en: Download the Lalamove driver app as directed, install it only from the official store listing, and register on your own phone.

steps.zh-TW: 註冊頁請使用推薦碼 2VPF5B（已在連結中；手動輸入請依原樣含大小寫）。依分享文案，未使用推薦碼註冊，推薦視為無效。
steps.en: Use code 2VPF5B on the registration page (already in the link; if typed, enter it exactly as shown). Per the share text, a referral without it is invalid.

steps.zh-TW: 依 App 指示完成註冊並等待審核；通過審核才算加入。
steps.en: Follow the app to finish registration and wait for review; you join only after approval.

intro.zh-TW: 貨運與外送平台的司機 App，註冊時使用推薦碼，通過審核才算加入。
intro.en: Lalamove’s driver-partner app: register with the code; joining needs approval.

description.zh-TW:
Lalamove 司機版是貨運與外送平台 Lalamove 的司機 App。這是工作申請，不是一般會員註冊：需要註冊並通過審核才算加入。

推薦碼 2VPF5B 已包含在連結中，註冊頁請使用這組碼。連結只能在手機開啟，桌面瀏覽器只會顯示請改用手機。實際條件以 Lalamove 官方公告為準。
description.en:
Lalamove 司機版 is the driver-partner app of Lalamove, a freight and delivery platform. Joining is a job application, not a plain member sign-up: you register and pass a review.

Referral code 2VPF5B is already part of the link, so use it on the registration page. The link opens only on a mobile device; a desktop browser shows a message asking you to switch to a phone. Actual terms follow Lalamove’s official announcements.

notes.zh-TW: 分享文案要求在 2026-10-31 前註冊並通過審核。lalamove-driver.onelink.me 是共用服務 onelink.me 下 Lalamove 的專屬主機；短網址的終點可由擁有者變更，請確認最終網址。2026-10-24 以桌面瀏覽器開啟，會轉到 lalamove.com 的子網域並顯示請改用手機。本站沒有測試推薦碼是否被接受。請只用官方 App 註冊，不要向 App 以外的人付款。
notes.en: Per the share text, register and pass review before 2026-10-31. lalamove-driver.onelink.me is Lalamove’s own host on the shared onelink.me service; the destination of a short link can be changed by its owner, so check the final address. Opened on a desktop on 2026-10-24, it went to a lalamove.com subdomain asking for a phone. This site did not test whether the code is accepted at sign-up. Register only in the official app and pay no one outside it.

q.zh-TW: Lalamove 司機版的推薦碼 2VPF5B 怎麼用？
q.en: How do I use Lalamove driver referral code 2VPF5B?

a.zh-TW: 推薦碼已在連結中，請在註冊頁使用。依分享文案，使用推薦碼註冊並完成加入才算推薦成功，否則視為無效；須用本人手機註冊，不要登入他人裝置。
a.en: The code is already in the link; use it on the registration page. Per the share text, a referral counts only if you register with the code and finish joining; otherwise it is invalid. Register on your own phone, not on someone else’s device.

a.zh-TW: 分享文案只寫「完成任務就送獎金」，沒有寫金額、任務內容與領取對象，所以本頁不列優惠。被邀請的司機是否有獎勵，以 Lalamove 官方推薦活動頁與 App 為準。
a.en: The share text only says a bonus comes with completing tasks and gives no amount, task details or recipient, so no offer is listed here. Whether an invited driver gets a reward follows Lalamove’s official referral page and the app.
